sentence: نْحِبّ نِشْرِي voiture جْدِيدَة هَاذَا الْعَام
raw: نحب نشري voiture جديدة هاذا العام
ipa: ˈnħibb ˈniʃriː vwaˈtiːr ˈʒdiːda ˈhɛːðɛː ˈlʕaːm
gloss_en: I want to buy a new car this year
notes: [fr-cs] voiture 'car' → [vwaˈtiːr]: Fr /y/→[iː], uvular /ʁ/→native /r/, /v/ retained (Tunis French adstrate; singer1984, gibson2009 EALL 'Tunis Arabic'). PIPELINE WRONG (en-GB donor default): emits 'fuitjuːr'. table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

gloss_en: my mobile phone doesn't work well
notes: [fr-cs] portable 'mobile' → [purˈtabl]: Fr /p/ retained (adstrate), /ɔ/→[u], /ʁ/→[r]. PIPELINE WRONG (en donor): 'buːrtabl' (/p/→[b], spurious length). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

gloss_en: there is a big problem at work
notes: [fr-cs] problème 'problem' → [pruˈblɛːm]: /p/ retained, /ʁ/→[r], /ɔ/→[u]. PIPELINE WRONG (en donor): 'brublm' (/p/→[b], vowel dropped). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

gloss_en: I paid the electricity bill yesterday
notes: [fr-cs] facture 'bill' → [fakˈtuːra], the integrated Tunis form (final syllabic /ʁ/ resolved with an epenthetic [a], as in the parallel Romance loan; holes2004). PIPELINE WRONG (en donor): 'faktjuːr'. table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

gloss_en: I have an appointment with the doctor tomorrow
notes: [fr-cs] rendez-vous 'appointment' → [rɑndiːˈvuː]: nasal /ɑ̃/→[ɑn], /e/→[iː], /v/ retained. PIPELINE WRONG (en donor): 'rindizfaws' (reads the digraph as English). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

sentence: هَاذَا شِي normal مَا تْخَمِّمْش بَرْشَة
raw: هاذا شي normal ما تخممش برشة
ipa: ˈhɛːðɛː ˈʃiː nurˈmaːl ˈmɛː txaˈmmimʃ ˈbarʃa
gloss_en: this is normal, don't think too much
notes: [fr-cs] normal → [nurˈmaːl]: /ɔ/→[u], /ʁ/→[r]. PIPELINE WRONG (en donor): 'nuːrmal' (spurious length, English stress). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

gloss_en: give me a pen to write with
notes: [fr-cs] stylo 'pen' → [stiːˈlu]: Fr /y/→[iː], /o/→[u]; well-integrated Tunis loan. PIPELINE WRONG (en donor): 'stilu' (short [i], mis-stressed). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

gloss_en: thank you very much for the help
notes: [fr-cs] merci 'thanks' → [mɛrˈsi]: Fr /ɛ/ kept, /ʁ/→[r]. PIPELINE WRONG (en donor): 'marsi' (/ɛ/→[a]). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

sentence: نْشُوفَك فِي weekend إِنْ شَاءَ الله
raw: نشوفك في weekend إن شاء الله
ipa: ˈnʃuːfak ˈfiː wiːkind ˈʔin ˈʃɛːʔa ˈallah
gloss_en: we'll see you on the weekend, God willing
notes: [en-cs] weekend→wiːkind. English guest (English is the minority CS donor in Tunis; French dominates). imāla raises شَاءَ→[ʃɛːʔa]. table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

sentence: عَنْدِي laptop جْدِيد أَمَّا wifi بَطِيء
raw: عندي laptop جديد أما wifi بطيء
ipa: ˈʕandiː labtub ˈʒdiːd ˈʔammɛː wifi bɑˈtˤiːʔ
gloss_en: I have a new laptop but the wifi is slow
notes: [en-cs] laptop→labtub (/p/→[b]); wifi→wifi. أَمَّا 'but' (Tunis). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

gloss_en: send me the email about the meeting
notes: [en-cs] email→imel; meeting→miːtinɡ (/ŋ/→[nɡ]). genitive exponent مْتَاع (Tunis). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

gloss_en: I buy everything online a lot
notes: [en-cs] online→unlin. برشة 'a lot' (Tunis hallmark). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

gloss_en: I have a new telephone at home
notes: [loan] loan تلفون (< Fr téléphone) → [tiliˈfuːn], the attested Tunis form (singer1984; supplemental letters پ ڤ گ per NOTA/turki2024). Pipeline reads the vocalised loan natively and matches. table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

gloss_en: I went to Sfax by bus yesterday
notes: [loan] loan كار (< Fr/It car 'coach') → [kaːr]: IMĀLA BLOCKED before /r/, so the long vowel keeps its back [aː] (singer1984 imāla-block; gibson2009) — cf. the raised default elsewhere. table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

gloss_en: give me the fork so I can eat
notes: [loan] loan فرشيطة (< Fr fourchette 'fork') → [farˈʃiːtˤɑ], attested Tunis household loan (singer1984, gibson2009); ط emphatic backs the following vowel to [ɑ]. Pipeline matches. table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

gloss_en: I took my grandfather to the hospital yesterday
notes: [loan] loan سبيطار (< Fr/It (h)ospital) → [sbiːˈtˤɑːr], attested Tunis form; emphatic backing [ɑː]. STRESS ARTIFACT (documented, kept as engine truth): pipeline emits 'sbiˈːtˤɑːr' with the stress mark inside the length mark — cf. the ar-EG rows. table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

sentence: نِمْشِي لِلْبِيرُو كُلّ صْبَاح فِي تُونِس
raw: نمشي للبيرو كل صباح في تونس
ipa: ˈnimʃiː lilˈbiːruː ˈkull ˈsˤbaːħ ˈfiː ˈtuːnis
gloss_en: I go to the office every morning in Tunis
notes: [loan] loan بيرو (< Fr bureau 'office/desk') → [biːru], attested everyday Tunis loan (singer1984). Pipeline reads the vocalised loan natively and matches. table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

gloss_en: hello, how are you?
notes: [arabizi] Arabizi (Tunisian 3arabi): 3=ع, 7=ح, 9=ق. Spells عَسْلَامَة شْنُوَّة أَحْوَالَك (Tunis greeting formula; singer1984). No Arabizi path in the pipeline; ipa hand-derived as the Tunis reading, with imāla عَسْلَامَة→[ʕaslɛːma], أَحْوَالَك→[ʔaħwɛːlak]. table: n/a

gloss_en: where did you go yesterday?
notes: [arabizi] Arabizi: 7=ح. Spells وِين مْشِيت الْبَارِح. ipa hand-derived; بَارِح→[baːriħ] with imāla blocked before /r/ (singer1984). table: n/a

gloss_en: please call me before you come
notes: [arabizi] Arabizi: 3=ع, 9=ق, T=ط. Spells يَعَيْشِك عَيَّطْلِي قَبْل مَا تْجِي. ipa hand-derived; the historical /aj/ of يَعَيْشِك MONOPHTHONGISES to [iː] → [jaʕiːʃik] (AR_TN_MONO_AJ; gibson2009, singer1984) — a blind-round under-applied this ay→iː, but the cited Tunis rule stands. table: n/a
